brief:
Aber Kawas, the first Palestinian American elected to the New York state senate, told Al Jazeera that the war in Gaza and affordability crises in New York prompted her entry into politics. Kawas, who will represent a district in New York, cited both the humanitarian toll abroad and economic pressures facing constituents at home as motivating factors for her campaign.

The senator-elect's victory marks a milestone for Palestinian American political representation in New York state politics. Her platform addressed interconnected concerns spanning international conflict and domestic economic hardship.
dek: Palestinian American senator-elect Aber Kawas says Gaza and affordability in New York drove her into politics.
title: Palestinian American elected to New York state senate
